title: Little Boy Outside House, July 1948 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A post-World War II era black-and-white snapshot captures a young curly-haired toddler standing on a concrete walkway beside a house with white siding and a brick base. He wears summer shortalls and sandals while posing in front of a small wooden step stool. The handwritten inscription on the back indicates the photograph was taken in July 1948 during a visit to 'Aunt Mildred'.
